tagline: Eat Smarter. Scan Before You Buy.
welcome_desc: Scan packaged foods in supermarkets and instantly understand how they fit your personal health & nutrition goals.
compare_hint: Select 2 or 3 products to evaluate side-by-side for your profile
onboarding_step_2_subtitle: Tell us a little about yourself.
onboarding_step_3_subtitle: Do any of these apply to you?
onboarding_step_3_notice: This information is used strictly to personalize food nutrition evaluations.
onboarding_step_4_subtitle: Do you avoid any specific foods or allergens?
onboarding_step_5_subtitle: Do you currently take any medicines?
onboarding_step_5_notice: Medication information is saved for your personal records. This app provides non-clinical nutrition guidance.
scan_barcode_hint: Point camera at the barcode on the package
scan_label_hint: Photograph the Nutrition Facts and Ingredients table
guidance_score_sub: App-generated heuristic — not a clinical measurement.
missing_data_notice: Data Incomplete: Some nutrition facts were not listed on this package label.
no_scans_yet: No scans yet. Tap below to scan your first product!
disclaimer_text: This app provides general nutritional information and a Personalized Guidance Score based on public guidelines (FSSAI, ICMR-NIN, WHO) and your inputs. It is an app-generated heuristic, not medical advice, a clinical diagnosis, or a guarantee of safety. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical decisions.
allergy_disclaimer: Always verify the physical package label before consuming, especially for severe allergies.
better_alternatives_subtitle: Ranked specifically based on your dietary and health profile
